review_rule: review_recommended = disagreement OR verifier OOD flag; review flag is not a diagnosis and does not rewrite grade

state_rule.AGREE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE: decisions agree and neither probability is within 0.05 of its frozen threshold
state_rule.AGREE_LOW_CONFIDENCE: decisions agree and either probability is within 0.05 of its frozen threshold
state_rule.DISAGREE: primary and verifier binary decisions differ
state_rule.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: reserved for missing/failed signals; not silently converted to a prediction
